claims.text: Amanyara is on the quiet northwest tip of the island, about 25 minutes from Providenciales.

findings.quote: Amanyara is located about 25 minutes from Providenciales, on the quiet northwest tip, making for extraordinary sunsets.

claims.text: The resort borders Northwest Point National Park, which is good for birdwatching and exploring underwater caves.

findings.quote: It borders Northwest Point National Park, which is excellent for birdwatching and exploring a network of underwater caves.

claims.text: The name Amanyara combines Aman, meaning peace in Sanskrit, and Yara, meaning place in the language of the Arawak people who once lived on Turks and Caicos.

findings.quote: Amanyara is a portmanteau of Aman, meaning ‘peace’ in Sanskrit, and Yara, meaning ‘place’ in the language of the Arawak people who once lived on Turks and Caicos.

claims.text: The resort's tranquil structures channel Aman's Asian roots and are heavy on timbers and bamboo.

findings.quote: channels the brand’s Asian roots in its tranquil structures, heavy on timbers and bamboo

claims.text: The resort has one- and two-bedroom pavilions and three- to six-bedroom villas.

findings.quote: the resort consists of one-to-two bedroom pavilions and three-to-six bedroom villas

claims.text: Each villa has its own pool, golf cart parking and outdoor area.

findings.quote: Each villa has its own pool, golf cart parking, and outdoor area.

claims.text: Beach Path Tranquillity Villas reach the beach within a three-minute walk along a dedicated footpath.

findings.quote: Beach Path Tranquillity Villas offer access to the beach within a three-minute walk via a dedicated footpath.

claims.text: Dining centres on The Restaurant with ocean-view terraces, The Bar and the seasonal Beach Club.

findings.quote: three main places to eat, including The Restaurant, where tables spill out from an open-walled dining area across terraces with fantastic ocean views, The Bar, and the seasonal Beach Club

claims.text: The resort has four clay Har-tru tennis courts.
The spa has four treatment rooms, a relaxation pavilion, an outdoor yoga sala and a pool.

findings.quote: Comprehensive spa with 4 treatment rooms, a relaxation pavilion, outdoor yoga sala and pool

claims.text: Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host and Chef who stay on site for the duration of every stay.

findings.quote: Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host and Chef that stay on-site for the duration of every stay.

claims.text: Beach Sala Villas sit on the sand, with direct beach access via a private beach sala extending from the terrace.

findings.quote: Beach Sala Villas are located on the sand with direct access via a private beach sala extending from their terrace.

claims.text: Amanyara opened in 2006 as the first Aman property in the Caribbean.

findings.quote: It opened as the first property in the Caribbean from luxury resort portfolio Aman back in 2006

claims.text: The Six-Bedroom Amanyara Villa has a private gym and a steam room in the primary guest pavilion.

findings.quote: the Six-Bedroom Amanyara Villa features a private gym and a steam room in the primary guest pavilion.

claims.text: The resort runs a kids program called Nature Discovery, with sailing and mountain biking for older kids and sailing and kitesurfing lessons for younger kids.

findings.quote: an incredibly engaging kids program called Nature Discovery, where older kids can go sailing and mountain biking while younger kids can learn to sail and take kitesurfing lessons

claims.text: The resort lists a 25-minute drive transfer from Providenciales International Airport (PLS).
The cost of food is not included in a villa stay, whether dining in the resort restaurants or in the villa.

findings.quote: The cost of food is not included, whether dining in the resort restaurants or in the villa.

claims.text: Villas other than the Beach Sala and Beach Path villas are about seven minutes by golf cart from the resort's public areas.

findings.quote: All other villas are approximately seven minutes by golf cart to the resort's public areas
